(MED 23)
Publication Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India
AMENDMENT NO. 1 DECEMBER 2019
TO
IS 17150 : 2019 MINI DOMESTIC WATER HEATER
FOR USE WITH PIPED NATURAL GAS ( PNG ) —
SPECIFICATION
(Page 1, clause 1.1) — Substitute the following for the existing Note:

‘NOTE — CNG filled cylinder or PNG may be used for performance test and test according
to 4.1.9 and 4.1.11.’
[Page 3, clause 13.1.1 (b)] — Substitute the following for the existing:
‘b) 200 litre capacity overhead water tank shall be fixed in testing room
at 2 to 3 m water head as per Fig. 1.’
(Page 4, clause 16) — Substitute the following for the existing clause:
‘16 THERMAL EFFICIENCY
When tested as prescribed in Annex B, the thermal efficiency of the water heater
shall not be less than 62 percent.’
(Page 4, clause 26) — Substitute the following for the existing Note:

‘NOTE — Inlet water temperature shall be 27 ± 2°C.’
(Page 5, Fig. 1) — Substitute ‘2 to 3 m WATER HEAD’ for ‘2 m WATER
HEAD’.
